theater: 布哈拉城西南札拉夫尚河谷

battle.name: 布哈拉之戰
battle.theater: 布哈拉城西南札拉夫尚河谷
battle.brief: 公元五五七年，薩珊皇帝霍斯勞一世在布哈拉城西南的札拉夫尚河谷平原上，與新起的突厥汗國夾擊嚈噠帝國主力，替祖父卑路斯一世雪恥。薩珊重騎兵以合圍破陣，嚈噠營帳與財貨盡失，王族南奔。卡面月牙劍屬公元前十五世紀埃及工藝，不會出現在這片平原；當年近東騎兵用的是同源演生的曲刃佩刀。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 本場戰役把三個軍事集團拉進同一片戰場，外加被捲入的粟特城邦與旁觀的拜占庭。交戰一方是薩珊帝國：都城泰西封，執政者為霍斯勞一世·安努什爾萬，東方防線由呼羅珊總督與地方貴族分掌，出征主力是薩珊重騎兵（asawira），輔以步兵、弓手與攻城器械，遠征的後勤核心是隨軍移動的達漢·古爾珊。另一方是嚈噠帝國，即漢籍所稱的白匈奴，其核心在巴克什與木鹿一帶，騎兵是立國之柱，徵發範圍涵蓋舒格南、阿穆爾、贊木、胡實、忒爾木茲一帶。第三方是新立的突厥汗國：可汗居帳於北方草原，鐵勒與粟特籍兵員充當步兵與工匠，弓騎與快速換馬是它投入中亞的看家本領。粟特城市如布哈拉、撒馬爾罕原受嚈噠宗主保護，戰中向薩珊輸送糧秣與嚈噠方面的徵發，糧道長短幾乎與刀兵同等重要。拜占庭並未參戰，但正是西線的和平讓霍斯勞可以把東線的兵全部押上。
countriesEn: This campaign pulled three military blocs onto the same ground, together with the Sogdian city-states that were caught up in it and the Byzantines, who watched from the west. On one side stood the Sasanian Empire: capital Ctesiphon, ruled by Khosrow I Anushirvan, its eastern line of defence divided between the marzban of Khurasan and the provincial nobility, the striking core of any expedition being the heavy cavalry of the asawira, supported by infantry, archers and siege engines, and the logistical heart of a campaign being the Dahan-e Gholshan, the mobile treasury and supply depot that travelled with the army. The other side was the Hephthalite empire, the White Huns of the Chinese sources, whose core lay around Balkh and Merv, whose strength was cavalry, and whose recruitment reached as far as Shughnan, Amol, Zamm, Khuttal and Termez. The third party was the newly founded Turkic Khaganate: the khan ruled from a tent-steppe far to the north, Tiele and Sogdian recruits served as infantry and craftsmen, and mounted archery with rapid remounts was what it brought into Central Asia. Sogdian cities such as Bukhara and Samarkand had previously sat under Hephthalite protection; during the war they delivered grain to the Sasanians and levies to the Hephthalites, so that the length of the supply line counted for nearly as much as the fighting. Byzantium fought nowhere, yet it was the western peace that allowed Khosrow to commit the bulk of his forces to the east.
people: 霍斯勞一世（Khosrow I Anushirvan，公元五三一至五七九年在位）是本役的策劃者；他在西線與拜占庭達成長久和約之後，注意力整體轉向東方，決心清算四八四年祖父卑路斯一世死於嚈噠之手、呼羅珊大片淪陷的舊帳。史料多把布哈拉之戰的指揮記在國王本人或呼羅珊總督名下，戰場上沒有留下薩珊方面指揮者的確切姓名；同期在西線平定尼西比斯叛亂的名將舒沙與布茲，正是在東線吃緊時替國王騰出手腳的人。突厥方面推動聯盟的是阿史那氏的始祖可汗伊思泰米，他與兄長分治汗國東西，於五百五十年代把部眾推向中亞；粟特人馬尼亞赫約在五百五十九年前後出使突厥帳，替薩珊說項並求援。嚈噠方面的記錄最為分歧：《波斯諸王史》說王子在會戰中陣亡、國王與殘部南走；另一系史料記國王加德法爾逃入薩珊境內，太子法干尼什經突厥冊立，於查格尼揚另立小國，後赴泰西封朝覲，成為薩珊認可的附庸。
peopleEn: Khosrow I Anushirvan (r. 531-579) was the architect of the campaign. Having concluded a long peace with Byzantium in the west, he turned his attention wholesale towards the east, determined to settle the old account of the death of his grandfather Peroz I at the hands of the Hephthalites in 484 and of the loss of much of Khorasan. The sources generally place the command of the Battle of Bukhara with the king himself or with the marzban of Khurasan; the field commander on the Sasanian side is not named in any surviving record. Shush and Buz, the generals who were putting down the revolt at Nisibis in the west during these same years, were precisely the men who freed the king's hands for the eastern front. On the Turkic side the alliance was driven by Istami of the Ashina, who shared the khaganate with his elder brother and pushed his people into Central Asia during the 550s; a Sogdian emissary, Maniakh, reached the Turkic tent around 559 to argue the Sasanian case in search of help. The Hephthalite side is the most contradictory in the record: the Pei Shou says the prince was killed in the battle and that the king fled south with the survivors, while another line of sources has the king Ghadfar fleeing into Sasanian territory, the prince Faghanish being invested by the Turks, founding a small state in Chaghaniyan, and afterwards going to Ctesiphon to do homage and be acknowledged as a Sasanian vassal.
kits: 卡面兵器是埃及月牙劍（Khopesh），公元前十五世紀的青銅鐮形單刃劍，外彎的刃在砍中之後不必拔劍再揮，是埃及近身搏鬥的舊式裝備；它比本役早約兩千一百年，絕不可能出現在札拉夫尚河谷。值得留意的是形制的延續：鐮形單刃的傳統並未在近東中斷，薩珊騎兵的曲刃佩刀即由這一脈的鐮形短劍與月形刃演成，故卡面兵器與本役的兵器譜系仍有連續性，只是工藝與年代差了二十個世紀以上。薩珊重騎兵的裝備是頭盔、鎖子甲與札甲、圓盾、長矛、標槍與薩珊弓，配高橋鞍、馬鐙、馬胸帶與飾有金屬片的馬具，遠征車隊靠駱駝、馬匹與隨軍放牧的畜群維持。嚈噠以複合弓騎射見長，配簡鐵盔與輕甲，另有長矛與彎刀，也善用攻城器械圍城。突厥以長複合弓、短刀、狼牙棒、皮甲與高鞍為主，馬匹多而換馬快，帳篷與肉乳製品便於隨軍移動。粟特人則提供箭手、商隊與絲路城鎮的糧秣。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Egyptian khopesh, a bronze sickle-shaped single-edged sword of the fifteenth century BC, whose outward curve let the wielder swing again without pulling the blade free, an older style of close-quarter fighting from Egypt. It predates this battle by some two thousand one hundred years and could not possibly have been on the Zarafshan plain. What is worth noting is the continuity of the form: the sickle-bladed single edge never died out in the Near East, and the curved sabre of the Sasanian horsemen grew out of that same line of sickle swords and lunate blades, so the card weapon still belongs to the same arms lineage as this battle, differing only in workmanship and date by more than twenty centuries. The Sasanian heavy cavalry carried helmets, mail and scale armour, round shields, long spears, javelins and Sasanian bows, and rode high-canted saddles fitted with stirrups, breast straps and plated harness; the baggage trains moved on camels, horses and herds driven along behind the column. The Hephthalites were famous for composite-bow horse archery, wearing plain iron helmets and light armour, and adding long lances and curved blades; they were also skilled at besieging towns with siege engines. The Turks relied on long composite bows, short swords, clubs, leather armour and high saddles, kept very many horses so that remounts were quick, and lived off tents and milk-and-meat provisions that could travel with them. Sogdians supplied archers, caravans and the grain of the Silk Road towns.
tactics: 這是一場典型的兩面夾擊。薩珊與突厥商定在同一季節各自壓進：突厥自北方越過錫爾河上游草原，由北面掃蕩嚈噠的牧地與盟友；薩珊自呼羅珊南下，沿阿姆河與錫爾河之間的通道直取布哈拉與巴克什，把嚈噠夾在兩支大軍之間。波斯與英文史料都指出，嚈噠雖有強悍的騎兵，卻缺乏同時應付兩個戰場的組織，這正是它崩解的主因。會戰本身發生在布哈拉附近的札拉夫尚河谷平原：薩珊騎兵不急著正面硬撞，而是先以弓矢擾亂、封鎖河谷兩側出口，再以密集縱隊的長矛衝鋒插入敵陣，隨即包圍嚈噠的營地，把營帳、旗幟與財貨一併奪下；追擊潰兵與收降殘部是戰役的後半程。遠征補給才是薩珊的真正難題：從泰西封到布哈拉直線近兩千公里，糧食靠粟特城鎮徵發、靠達漢·古爾珊隨軍倉庫與駱駝隊運送，馬匹草料沿途放牧解決，任何一段斷鏈都會拖垮全軍。
tacticsEn: This was a classic two-pronged pincer. The Sasanians and the Turks agreed to converge in the same season: the Turks crossed the upper Jaxartes from the north, sweeping the Hephthalite pastures and their allies, while the Sasanians came down out of Khurasan along the corridor between the Oxus and the Jaxartes and struck at Bukhara and Balkh, catching the Hephthalites between two armies. Persian and English-language accounts alike stress that the Hephthalites had formidable cavalry but lacked the organisation to fight on two fronts at once, and that this, rather than any shortage of men, is what destroyed them. The engagement itself took place on the open ground of the Zarafshan valley near Bukhara: the Sasanian horsemen did not charge head-on at once, but first harried with arrows and shut off both ends of the valley, then drove long-spear columns into the enemy line, encircling the Hephthalite camp and taking the tents, standards and baggage with it; chasing the fugitives and accepting the surrender of the remnants formed the second half of the battle. Supply was the Sasanians' real difficulty: the direct line from Ctesiphon to Bukhara is close to two thousand kilometres, and the food had to come from levies on Sogdian towns, from the mobile storehouses of the Dahan-e Gholshan and from camel trains, with fodder for the horses provided by grazing them along the route. A single break in that chain would have stalled the whole army.
data: 這場戰役留下的精確數字極少，後人只能從地理與制度反推。距離是比較可靠的：泰西封至布哈拉的直線距離近兩千公里，行程須穿過呼羅珊盆地與錫爾河、阿姆河之間的河間地，全程由薩珊的稅制與行軍縱隊支撐。水系決定了戰場：札拉夫尚河流經布哈拉城，兩側為平坦可馳兵的谷地；阿姆河是後來薩珊與突厥劃出的勢力分界，錫爾河是突厥西境的分界，興都庫什山脈替南面提供屏障。兵力的唯一具體線索來自費爾道西《列王紀》所列的嚈噠聯軍名錄：巴克什、舒格南、阿穆爾、贊木、胡實、忒爾木茲、華什吉爾德等地都出兵相助，但全無總數；波斯方面同樣沒有留下可核的兵力表。制度上的數字倒有記載：薩珊的達漢·古爾珊是隨軍的移動國庫與供應體系，據說可支應十萬人的糧秣，另有金銀財貨隨軍移動；薩珊弓與複合弓的有效射程約在數十步至百步之間，重騎兵衝鋒的速度則依馬種與地形而變。年代本身也有兩說，中文敘述繫於五五七年，現代研究多繫於五百六十年代中期。
dataEn: Very few precise figures survive for this battle, and later writers can only reconstruct them from geography and institutions. Distance is the most reliable: the straight line from Ctesiphon to Bukhara is close to two thousand kilometres, and the march had to cross the Khurasan basin and the land between the Jaxartes and the Oxus, sustained throughout by the Sasanian tax system and by the marching column. Water determined the ground: the Zarafshan runs through the city of Bukhara with flat, rideable country on either side; the Oxus became the line dividing Sasanian and Turkic power, the Jaxartes marked the Turkic western frontier, and the Hindu Kush gave cover to the south. The only concrete clue to numbers of men comes from the list of the Hephthalite coalition in Firdausi's Shahnameh: Balkh, Shughnan, Amol, Zamm, Khuttal, Termez and Washgird all sent contingents, but no total is anywhere given, and the Persian side likewise left no verifiable table of strength. The institutional figures are better attested: the Dahan-e Gholshan was a mobile treasury and supply system that travelled with the army and is said to have provisioned a hundred thousand men, with bullion and treasure moving with it; the effective range of Sasanian and composite bows ran to some dozens of paces up to a hundred; and the speed of a heavy cavalry charge varied with horse and terrain. The date itself is disputed, with the Chinese narrative placing the battle in 557 and most modern studies putting it in the mid-to-late 560s.
cause: 直接起因是四八四年薩珊王卑路斯一世在赫拉特一帶戰死於嚈噠之手，呼羅珊大部隨之淪陷，嚈噠每年向薩珊索取貢賦，這筆舊債薩珊一直無力償還。五三二年霍斯勞一世即位後厲兵秣馬，五四二年前後嚈噠再聯合貴霜餘部攻入呼羅珊、包圍木鹿，薩珊主將沙赫爾巴爾茲在阿蘭長城一線再敗，兵威與國威都跌到谷底。遠征的直接推力是霍斯勞的東進計畫：他要在西線和約解除後，把兵鋒一次推過錫爾河，重新切斷嚈噠控制的中亞商路。但薩珊不敢單獨對付嚈噠的騎兵，必須找一個能從北面牽制的盟友；五百五十年代突厥汗國崛起，把牧地與城市網一齊推向中亞，兩方因此走到一起。此外，中亞城邦秩序長期真空，誰控制布哈拉、巴克什與絲路稅關，誰就控制東西方的商品交換，這才是雙方真正要爭的東西。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the death of the Sasanian king Peroz I at the hands of the Hephthalites near Herat in 484, after which much of Khorasan was lost and the Hephthalites began drawing tribute from the Sasanians, a debt the Persians had been unable to pay for two generations. Khosrow I took the throne in 532 and rebuilt his forces; around 542 the Hephthalites, allied with the remaining Kushan elements, struck back into Khurasan and besieged Merv, and the Sasanian commander Shahrbaraz was beaten again at the Wall of the Alans, so that Persian military and Persian prestige both reached their lowest point in a generation. The impulse behind the expedition was Khosrow's eastern plan: with the western peace concluded, he meant to drive his armies past the Jaxartes in one stroke and cut the Hephthalite grasp on the Central Asian trade routes. But the Sasanians dared not face the Hephthalite cavalry alone and needed an ally able to pin them from the north; the rise of the Turkic khaganate in the 550s, driving both pastures and city networks into Central Asia, brought the two together. Underneath it all lay the long vacuum in the order of the Central Asian city-states: whoever held Bukhara, Balkh and the toll gates of the Silk Road controlled the exchange of goods between east and west, and that was the substance each side was contesting.
impact: 此役之後，嚈噠帝國作為一個統一政權在史料中消失，碎片化為若干小邦，最明確的是查格尼揚的法干尼什小國；薩珊得以把阿姆河以南的呼羅珊與粟特諸城重新收編，粟特人從嚈噠的臣民變成薩珊的臣民，布哈拉自此成為薩珊東方防務與商稅的支點，而它此前的僧團與經典傳播也讓中亞佛教與伊朗語系的接觸更早連成一條線。對薩珊而言，東線的勝負讓霍斯勞可以把力量轉回西線，帝國在五七〇年代達到巔峰；但同時在兩個方向上擴張，也為六世紀中葉以後的財政與兵源壓力埋下隱憂，最終在七世紀初薩珊被阿拉伯征服時已顯疲態。對突厥汗國而言，這是第一次以正規聯軍身分進入中亞，確立了草原與綠洲之間新的分贏方式；然而薩珊與突厥的友善只在數年之間有效，雙方都想獨吞絲路，五六八年突厥遣使拜占庭提議兩面夾擊薩珊，關係很快破裂。
impactEn: After this battle the Hephthalite empire disappears as a single polity in the sources and fragments into several small states, the clearest of them the kingdom of Faghanish in Chaghaniyan. The Sasanians recovered Khorasan south of the Oxus and the Sogdian cities, and the Sogdians passed from being subjects of the Hephthalites to subjects of the Sasanians; Bukhara became a hinge of Sasanian eastern defence and toll collection, and the monastic and textual transmission that had run through it earlier tied the Buddhist world of Central Asia to the Iranian-speaking world in an early chain of contacts. For the Sasanians, victory in the east allowed the weight of the empire to swing back west, and the empire reached its height in the 570s; but expansion on two fronts at once also laid down the financial and manpower strains that surfaced after the middle of the sixth century, and the Sasanians were visibly exhausted by the time the Arabs conquered them at the beginning of the seventh. For the Turkic khaganate this was the first entry into Central Asia as a regular coalition partner, fixing a new way of sharing out the steppe and the oasis lands between them; yet Sasanian and Turkic friendship lasted only a few years, since each wanted the Silk Road for itself, and in 568 the Turks sent an embassy to Byzantium proposing a two-front attack on the Sasanians.
result: 會戰以薩珊與突厥聯軍的完勝告終。布哈拉附近那場平原交鋒，嚈噠軍被合圍在營帳與車帳之間，營中財貨、牛羊與旗幟盡數被奪，王族成員或死於陣中或被俘；據說薩珊人把這個營地連同大批牲畜帶走，嚈噠人的帝國在幾年之間就散成了碎片，國王加德法爾帶殘部南逃入薩珊境內求助，太子法干尼什則被突厥另行冊立，於查格尼揚重建小國，後來接受薩珊的宗主地位並奉使朝覲。領土的分配隨之寫定：突厥取錫爾河以北，薩珊取阿姆河以南，阿姆河成為兩國的邊界線，粟特城邦回到薩珊的宗主圈內。最終收尾的其實不是這場會戰，而是十六年後突厥對嚈噠最後一名君主的清剿；自此呼羅珊與中亞城邦的秩序由薩珊與突厥分治，絲路北段的門戶向草原民族敞開，而布哈拉則從邊境戰場變成薩珊帝國東翼的商業與軍事重鎮。
resultEn: The engagement ended in a complete victory for the Sasanian-Turkic coalition. In the plain encounter near Bukhara the Hephthalite army was surrounded among its tents and wagons, its baggage, its cattle and its standards were taken, and members of the ruling house were either killed in the fighting or captured; the Persians reportedly carried off the camp together with great numbers of livestock, and within a few years the Hephthalite empire had dissolved into fragments. The king Ghadfar fled south into Sasanian territory to seek help, while the prince Faghanish was separately invested by the Turks, rebuilt a state in Chaghaniyan, and later accepted Sasanian suzerainty and sent missions to court. The division of territory was written into the settlement: the Turks took what lay north of the Jaxartes, the Sasanians what lay south of the Oxus, the Oxus became the frontier between the two powers, and the Sogdian cities returned to the Sasanian orbit. The final closure of the chapter was not this battle but the Turkic liquidation of the last Hephthalite ruler sixteen years later. From then on the order of Khurasan and the Central Asian city-states was shared between the Sasanians and the Turks, the northern gateway of the Silk Road stood open to the steppe peoples, and Bukhara changed from a frontier battlefield into the commercial and military hinge of the Sasanian Empire's eastern wing.
